verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.summerengine.com (HTTP 200) and a markdown version of each docs page (e.g. /mcp/agents.md) that points agents to the documentation index. The MCP server also ships docs search and read tools, so agents can pull Summer guidance in-chat. Missing for 10: no evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and the probes show little of llms.txt's depth or coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.summerengine.com/llms.txt
so the model can pull Summer guidance in-chat.
